title: M4 exit harness: 50 published environments, zero moderation misses, rate-spam + plausibility tests (AUTH #026)
summary: The M4 exit test (SPEC §8): drive 50 tester-published environments through publish → moderation → browse → rate → report end to end; confirm zero moderation misses in the Owner's review; verify the ranking survives a deliberate rate-spam test and the leaderboard rejects impossible times. Per SPEC §11 the human-judgment measures are suggestions; the security tests (rate-spam, plausibility) are merge gates.

acceptance_tests.test: 50 published environments flow through publish → moderation → browse → rate → report end to end without pipeline breakage.
Zero moderation misses in the Owner's review of the 50 (an Owner-judgment measure per SPEC §11, not a CI merge gate).
The ranking survives a deliberate rate-spam test and the leaderboard rejects a scripted impossible time (SECURITY_CHECKLIST §10.2/§10.3 — merge gates).
